Browse the PDFs in a folder without opening them.

Approval workflow

Create a signature block with the signature field for each person, ready to sign with a digital certificate in Acrobat Reader.

Document properties

Page tray and bin

Two temporary in-memory lists for the pages you take out of documents. Each page remembers its source document and page.

  • Tray (parked): to move sheets from one document to another. Drag pages onto it from the thumbnail strip or the Page organizer; with Ctrl they are copied without removing them from the document. Then drag them to the strip or to the tab of the target document.
  • Bin (discarded): what you give up. Del, the thumbnail × and the bin icon send pages there; you can still recover them.
  • Viewing them: click the zone or the «Tray» or «Bin» tab; they open in the viewer with two tabs. Esc or «Back» leaves; the tab's × closes it.
  • Undo: Ctrl+Z returns the page to the document. Inside the view, Ctrl+Z undoes the last change to the lists.
  • They are not saved on their own: they are lost when you close the app; save them as PDF if you want to keep them. On closing, the browser will warn you.

With this option off, deleting pages works as always: with confirmation and Ctrl+Z.

Compare revisions

Overlays two pages at the same scale: what is only in A is shown in red (removed) and what is only in B, in blue (added). What does not change, in grey.

This is a pixel comparison: it detects drawing and text changes but does not understand objects. If one version is shifted it is aligned automatically; if it is also scaled or rotated, use “Align with 2 points”.

mm

Dossier structures

Creates on the canvas a slot for each item of a structure and groups them with the matching bookmarks. Then you assign an open document (or pick one from the slot's list) and save the Final document. The structure is editable: you can add, remove or move nodes.

Certificate to sign with

The certificate (.p12 / .pfx) and its password are only used in memory while the application is open: they are not stored anywhere. When you save the Final document, it will be signed with this certificate.

Reusable parameters

Define a value just once (e.g. obra, promotor) and use it in the node texts (Header, Cover, Separators, Signature sheet…) as [@obra], and in the file name pattern as {@obra}. They are saved with the recipe.

Embed a PDF page

Drag over the preview to choose the area to embed.

      Sign with a digital certificate

      Signing is the final step. Any later change will invalidate the signature.

      PAdES (ETSI.CAdES.detached) with SHA-256 and RSA or EC keys (P-256, P-384, P-521). The private key is only used in memory and is not saved anywhere. The timestamp (TSA) needs a connection and is not included.

      Link to a URL

      Next you will drag a rectangle over the text, image or drawing you want to make clickable. It is saved in the PDF as a standard link.

      Video card

      A PDF cannot reliably embed a YouTube or Vimeo player: the card is an image with a link that opens in the browser. Nothing is downloaded from the Internet.

      Index from the bookmarks

      The index is inserted as editable A4 pages (texts and links). The page numbers already count the index pages.

      Automatic drawing index

      Mark on a page where the code and the title of the drawing are (in the title block). The zone is used on all pages; the text is read from the PDF, without OCR.

      Links between drawings

      Turns references to other drawings in the text (“see A-201”) into clickable links. In View mode, a click jumps to that drawing.

      Revision table

      Each revision cloud carries the number of the active revision inside a triangle (△). Here you can edit the descriptions, insert the table on the page (e.g. in the title block) or copy it to a spreadsheet.

      Sign with AutoFirma

      The browser cannot use the DNIe, smart cards (idCAT, professional bodies…) or certificates installed in Windows or macOS. For these cases, sign with AutoFirma (free government application) and reopen the PDF here to verify it:

      1. Save the final PDF with the button below (with the signature fields you have created). From this moment on, do not edit it any more.
      2. Open AutoFirma › Select file to sign › choose the PDF › Visible signature if you want to choose the field › Sign with the certificate or the card.
      3. Reopen it here: the mode Sign will show its verification and the document will be locked. For the next signature in the workflow, repeat step 2 with the already signed PDF.

      Header and footer

      The key Tab puts a separator there ⇥. A single part goes to centred; two go to left i right; three go to the left, centre and right.
